name: Misa
message: 「What's the big idea, calling me out here all of a sudden?」

name: Misa
message: 「I-it's not like I'm happy just because I got a present from you or anything!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just that I'd feel bad for you if I didn't take it, so I'm only accepting it for your sake!」

name: Misa
message: 「And the only reason I said thank you is because I don't want people calling me rude!」

name: Misa
message: 「It's the truth! Stop grinning like that!」
